741640101.text: ...What are you looking at? Never seen an adventurer before?

741640102.text: Well, what a coincidence. We're adventurers ourselves. What are you doing here?

741640103.text: We're looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum. It's gonna make us rich, Urville said so.

741640104.text: #Hey! Why are you telling {M#them}{F#them} about it?

741640105.text: Oh... In that case, no, we are definitely not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum!

741640106.text: You haven't been scammed, too, have you?

741640107.text: If you heard it from someone called Virgil, then, you've been lied to. There's no treasure. It's just a scam.

741640108.text: Ha! Like I'm gonna believe you! You just want to get us out of here so you can keep the treasure for yourself...

741640109.text: Do I look like a fool who just believes whatever someone says? I know what you're trying to do!

741640110.text: Alrighty then. Good luck to you.

741640111.text: It seems that some lessons must be experienced to be learned...

741642501.text: Treasure... where could it be? In a chest? In a cabinet? Or tucked away in some hidden compartment?

741642601.text: I'm sorry, I can't remember what the treasure is. If only I could remember... then I'd be able to help out more.

741642901.text: (It's a chest that looks like private property. Best not to touch it...)

741640201.text: I see! Ball Octopuses' eyes brighten up when they see your physique. But why, then, would you join the Fleet?

741640202.text: Because rumor has it that sailors make big bucks. It'll bring a much more stable income than what we're doing, trying to find some secret treasure...

741640203.text: Hey there. What are you two doing here?

741640204.text: Urville's doing physical training to join the Fleet... Joining the Fleet earns big bucks...

741640205.text: Nadia, I thought I told you to keep your mouth shut...

741640207.text: Hello, strangers. Urville is preoccupied with very important work, which is confidential, by the way. So, please leave us alone and keep your questions to yourselves.

741640209.text: Is that so? I'm sorry, I don't remember.

741640210.text: She suffered cranial damage previously, and she's kept on forgetting things since.

741640211.text: #Nadia, head back to shore with {M#them}{F#them} and rest a bit at The Rusty Rudder.

741640212.text: What about you? You don't look so good... Have you been...

741640213.text: That's not the case. Training is tough. Urville has to complete all the training courses in order to join the Fontaine Fleet.

741640214.text: Ah, you know me so well, Nadia. Now, hurry up and go.

741640216.text: Hey, let's not leave him here like that! Paimon feels he's just too embarrassed to ask for our help... You see, asking someone for help when you're in trouble isn't something to be ashamed of at all.

741640219.text: I—I told you I'm fine. Don't believe me? How about I do some push-ups right now?!

741640220.text: Wait, stop moving, you'll flip the wooden planks!

741640218.text: That's right. Asking help from passing adventurers when you're in trouble is not something to be ashamed of.

741640301.text: I didn't ask you to save me... How nosy. I'll just tell you upfront now — I have no Mora for you.

741640303.text: We can't just ignore a person in danger... That's not called being nosy.

741640306.text: That's too good to be true. I don't believe in kindness without agendas. I would've believed you more if I was some lovely damsel you'd come to save...

741640307.text: But the fact is, I look like an odd-flavored candy without any wrapping from the city's candy store. No one would take a second look, let alone pick me up.

741640308.text: If you didn't save me for Mora, then you must be up to something more sinister...

741640309.text: Whoa! This guy's head is so twisted... Paimon doesn't care if you believe us or not — we've always been bleeding hearts anyway. We didn't do it for Mora, but you at least owe us a "thank you"!

741640310.text: Thank you, strangers, for helping Urville. I wanted to help, but I never could be of any help... I'm just useless like that.

741640311.text: Don't say that about yourself, Nadia...

741640312.text: #Oh, we forgot to introduce ourselves. Paimon's name is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}.

741640313.text: D—Darn it, you want me to remember who I owe my life to, don't you?

741640314.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}, but even if you tell me your names, I'd forget them soon enough...

741640316.text: ...I told you. She's suffered cranial damage, so she often forgets things. Don't judge her by how she is now. She used to be an elite at the Marechaussee Phantom, you know?

741640317.text: But if it weren't for how she is now... She wouldn't have gotten mixed up with someone like me...

741640318.text: Yes. Urville saved me when I was severely wounded, but I didn't have any Mora to give him, so I want to repay him by helping him... But I often forget things, and I can't remember if I've ever been of help...

741640319.text: Don't worry, you've helped me out lots. There are many things I would never have achieved otherwise alone by myself.

741640320.text: Is that so? I must've forgotten it. But, I'm happy to hear that I'm not so useless after all.

741640321.text: If you want to collect your debt from us, can you wait until Urville is wealthy? Once we find the treasure, we'll be able to pay you back.

741640322.text: We're not collecting any debts! By the way, are you so fixated on finding the treasure and getting rich because you owe a lot of debts...?

741640323.text: To be honest with you... it's for her treatment. You've seen it yourselves how serious her forgetfulness is...

741640324.text: Just so you know, she used to be called Knowledgeable Nadia, and she could remember everything.

741640325.text: A full recovery is nearly impossible, but I want her to be able to return to a normal life at the very least... Even so, the medical expenses are going to be huge.

741640326.text: I am neither knowledgeable nor masterful, so all I can do is bet on luck. But I must say, my luck on bets has been very consistent. I have never won a gamble.

741640327.text: I thought I'd be able to find something of value inside or near that tower, but as it turned out, all I could find were shells and octopuses... and those octopuses even stole some things off us...

741640328.text: Not only did I lose my coin pouch and adventurer's gear... Even the diving set I rented from Pitot has sunk into the water... Haha... I'm really out of options.

741640330.text: That's because I'm despicable. I figure that if I say all these things, kind people like you wouldn't have the heart to ask me for things in return, right?

741640305.text: After all, our motto is "we can't sit idly by."

741640501.text: (Looks no different from any other treasure chest.)

741640502.text: Hey! What're you doing!? That's private property!

741640503.text: ...What are you looking at? Never seen an adventurer before?

741640504.text: Well, what a coincidence. We're adventurers ourselves. What are you doing here?

741640505.text: We're looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum. It's gonna make us rich, Urville said so.

741640506.text: #Hey! Why are you telling {M#them}{F#them} about it?

741640507.text: Oh... In that case, no, we are definitely not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum!

741640508.text: Thank you for informing us of the situation.

741640509.text: Darn... Well, even if you know, we were still here first. We'll definitely take the lead...

741640401.text: (Looks no different from any other treasure chest.)

741640402.text: Hey! What're you doing!? That's private property!

741640403.text: ...What are you looking at? Never seen an adventurer before?

741640404.text: Well, what a coincidence. We're adventurers ourselves. What are you doing here?

741640405.text: We're looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum. It's gonna make us rich, Urville said so.

741640406.text: #Hey! Why are you telling {M#them}{F#them} about it?

741640407.text: Oh... In that case, no, we are definitely not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum!

741640408.text: You haven't been scammed, too, have you?

741640409.text: If you heard it from someone called Virgil, then, you've been lied to. There's no treasure. It's just a scam.

741640410.text: Ha! Like I'm gonna believe you! You just want to get us out of here so you can keep the treasure for yourself...

741640411.text: Do I look like a fool who just believes whatever someone says? I know what you're trying to do!

741640412.text: Alrighty then. Good luck to you.

741640413.text: It seems that some lessons must be experienced to be learned...

741642001.text: ...What are you looking at? Never seen an adventurer before?

741642002.text: Well, what a coincidence. We're adventurers ourselves. What are you doing here?

741642003.text: We're looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum. It's gonna make us rich, Urville said so.

741642004.text: #Hey! Why are you telling {M#them}{F#them} about it?

741642005.text: Oh... In that case, no, we are definitely not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum!

741642006.text: Thank you for informing us of the situation.

741642007.text: Darn... Well, even if you know, we were still here first. We'll definitely take the lead...

741642101.text: I see! Ball Octopuses' eyes brighten up when they see your physique. But why, then, would you join the Fleet?

741642102.text: Because rumor has it that sailors make big bucks. It'll bring a much more stable income than what we're doing, trying to find some secret treasure...

741642103.text: Hey there. What are you two doing here?

741642104.text: Urville's doing physical training to join the Fleet... Joining the Fleet earns big bucks...

741642105.text: Nadia, I thought I told you to keep your mouth shut...

741642107.text: Hello, strangers. Urville is preoccupied with very important work, which is confidential, by the way. So, please leave us alone and keep your questions to yourselves.

741642109.text: Sorry, she suffered cranial damage previously, and she's kept on forgetting things since. What she says is not very coherent...

741642110.text: #Right. Nadia, head back to shore with {M#them}{F#them} and rest a bit at The Rusty Rudder.

741642111.text: What about you? You don't look so good... Have you been...

741642112.text: That's not the case. Training is tough. Urville has to complete all the training courses in order to join the Fontaine Fleet.

741642113.text: Ah, you know me so well, Nadia. Now, hurry up and go.

741642115.text: Hey, let's not leave him here like that! Paimon feels he's just too embarrassed to ask for our help... You see, asking someone for help when you're in trouble isn't something to be ashamed of at all.

741642118.text: I—I told you I'm fine. Don't believe me? How about I do some push-ups right now?!

741642119.text: Wait, stop moving, you'll flip the wooden planks!

741642117.text: That's right. Asking help from passing adventurers when you're in trouble is not something to be ashamed of.

741642201.text: You want to check on how we're progressing? I'm not telling you a word.

741642301.text: Sorry... but we are not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum.

741642401.text: Nadia's token is the most important thing, followed by my diving set... As long as I have it, I can dive. It's not to say that everything else is not important, it's just that...

741642402.text: The coin pouch... I—I do want to repay you for your troubles... But it's so little that I don't think you'd care for it...

741642701.text: Nervous? I'm hardly nervous at all!

741642703.text: How's my hair? How do I look? I'm not gonna embarrass myself by leaving something humiliating behind again, am I?

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to The Rusty Rudder to find Urville

741640601.text: We're back! Let's count... We found Nadia's token, the tripod, and the diving set, which is sadly a bit damaged... Oh, and we found your coin pouch, too!

741640602.text: Which did you lose? A coin pouch that's full of Mora or one without any?

741640603.text: C'mon, stop messing around. We only found one, so let's just return it to him. The Mora's for Nadia's treatment, after all.

741640604.text: Yes. It's not much, but thank... thank you for retrieving it for me.

741640606.text: Huh? Is it because... we robbed those Ball Octopuses in return?

741640607.text: Ugh... my arch-nemesis was so easily defeated by you two? You're no ordinary people for sure...

741640608.text: Arch-nemesis? You mean the Ball Octopuses?

741640609.text: Yeah, during the time that Nadia and I set up camp here, we had clashes with them every time we went diving... There was no winning side. We were evenly matched, you could say.

741640610.text: I made it my goal to defeat those worthy and admirable opponents myself... But I didn't expect you to take them down like that...

741640615.text: By the way, I found a piece of paper from my earlier ventures while you were down there. It's been on my person, so it didn't get wet.

741640616.text: But I can't understand a word of what's written on it. Maybe an adventurer with vast knowledge like you could decipher it.

741640617.text: I bet this thing is highly valuable. Consider it a token of my gratitude.

741640619.text: We also found this beautiful conch in the sea. Urville, please accept it.

741640621.text: Urville takes the tiny conch and examines it...

741640622.text: Strange. This conch resembles the one from your hometown, isn't it? No wonder you find it pretty. What's the word? Nostalgia? Does it remind you of home?

741640623.text: Well, not exactly. I had forgotten about it before, just like everything else, but when I saw it, I remembered. I saw it somewhere else, too. It's smaller than the one at Merusea Village, but bigger than this one.

741640624.text: It's a collector's item from a researcher who studied many things. Unlike Urville, he has vast knowledge and a lot of Mora.

741640625.text: But that was from a long time ago. He left many legacies, like the underwater shelter. I remember someone saying that there was treasure hidden there.

741640626.text: But who said it...? I'm sorry. I can't remember.

741640627.text: You're always apologizing, but it's not your fault. You don't have to apologize.

741640628.text: That's right! You're truly incredible, Nadia! Of course, it'd be even more incredible if you could remember where this treasure-filled underwater shelter is...

741640629.text: In the end... all you care about is still treasure!

741640614.text: Whether Urville can defeat you is one matter, but you can't really accept substitutes when exacting vengeance...

741641001.text: This is the place. I remember being here before.

741641002.text: Is there really treasure here? This place doesn't feel special at all...

741641003.text: Impressive. Deeming this kind of place not worth your attention based on experience and knowledge. Just like how easily you defeated my arch-nemesis... Now that I've seen how you work first-hand... I'm impressed.

741641004.text: One is quite all right, but I don't have confidence that I'll escape from a whole group of Fontemer Aberrants. Thinking back, I did get surrounded by a group of Ball Octopuses when I was small, and I nearly drowned.

741641005.text: It was fortunate that a kind-hearted Melusine saved me and took me to a luxurious room... much like the one we're standing in.

741641006.text: You really do have quite a connection with the Melusines.

741641007.text: True. The Melusines are nice to me. But I don't have much of a connection with humans... Guess that evens things out.

741641008.text: Never mind all that. Let's focus on getting rich!

741641009.text: Let's split up and see if we can find the legendary treasure.

741641701.text: (It takes you some effort to open the chest, but inside, there is only dust and powdery remains of... whatever the chest used to hold. Better not think about it.)

741641801.text: (By looking upwards to the point where your neck cannot bend back any further, you finally manage to make out some books that look interesting, but they have nothing to do with research whatsoever.)

741641802.text: (There are some yellowed blank sheets of paper and numerous empty ink bottles in the drawer.)

741641901.text: (There seems to be something beneath the laid out sheet music...)

741641902.text: What is this? The handwriting is barely legible... almost like a child wrote it... How strange, what it says seems oddly familiar... Could this be a coincidence?

741642801.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you're so kind... just like Urville.

741641201.text: Will we really find treasure here? We haven't found anything... besides a strange message that looks like it was written by a child...

741641202.text: We didn't find anything either. That strange message... may be a clue left behind by the researcher! You know how rich people like to do these fancy things...

741641203.text: You give the message to Urville...

741641204.text: Huh, you're right. It can't even be called writing. It's more like a child's scribblings...

741641209.text: Huh!? So this thing really did hold clues to the treasure? Paimon couldn't tell at all...

741641210.text: How should I put it... but the last line of the ugly handwriting says...

741641211.text: "Today's experience is a treasure to me. The Melusine is so nice to me. When I grow up, I want to be someone who helps others, too."

741641215.text: Enough... You must be laughing hard inside... Haha... I can't believe something so embarrassing came from me.

741641214.text: Y—You can't really say that! Well, Those words are priceless to him, aren't they?

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a picture for Urville and Nadia

741641301.text: Ready? Do you want to pose or something?

741641302.text: Hmm... Urville might look better sitting down. What should the background be?

741641304.text: Alright... And Nadia will stand beside me. Is this alright?

741641305.text: Well, except for your rigid expression, everything else looks fine!

741641313.text: Well, anyway! That'll be it, then. Say cheese!

741641307.text: I doubt I'd fit with my divesuit on...

741641308.text: It feels cramped... You might as well just stand.

741641310.text: You serious? Why not ask Nadia to sit? Go on, Nadia.

741641601.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. I'll treasure this photo... and remember how much you've helped us.

741641602.text: Hehe, by the way, you've remembered Paimon's name for a while now!

741641603.text: #Yes. Now, I know. Paimon must be as important to {NICKNAME} as Urville is to me.

741641605.text: But... I have to thank you for retrieving the tools for my trade. And now that I can dive again...

741641607.text: Of course! Why would I stop?

741641610.text: Being able to find treasure or not aside, if I gave it up, I would be giving up the possibility of ever getting rich.

741641611.text: That said, I could probably go find a stable job at Lumidouce Harbor... or perhaps be a maid in The Rusty Rudder?

741641609.text: That's asking me to give up on getting rich. No way.

741642120.text: You then save Urville, who fell into the water, and return to the shore with Nadia before settling down for a break at The Rusty Rudder.

741649901.text: Urville, the Ball Octopuses' eyes just lit up. Why is that?

741649902.text: Because they are envious of my physical constitution. I'll be able to join the Fleet if I keep my training up. They don't even have a chance.

741649903.text: This is the place. Now, we need to find <color=#00E1FFFF>Nadia's token and Urville's equipment — his diving set, coin pouch, and something like a tripod</color>...

741649904.text: Oh. But what does Nadia's token look like?

741649906.text: Huh...? We need to find a tiny cog in the vast ocean? But there might be all sorts of unrelated components sitting at the bottom of the ocean...

741649907.text: It's fine. My eyesight is great. I'd be able to remember as soon as I see it.

741649908.text: There are many Ball Octopuses around. The Ball Octopuses here and Urville are very alike.

741649910.text: Well... Because they all tend to act tough to try to intimidate their opponents. And, that they all like to collect shiny treasures.

741649911.text: The Ball Octopuses might've hidden our stuff inside the shells...

741649912.text: That must be the tripod all tangled up there... There should be a way to get it out, right?

741649913.text: #Got it! There's no way I'd have been able to get it back by myself... Thank you, {NICKNAME}.

741649915.text: You really found it? It looks like just any other cog... Paimon can't tell the difference.

741649916.text: You can if you're a Melusine. I'm not quite sure why, so I'm afraid I can't teach you how, sorry.

741649917.text: Hey, there's no need to apologize...

741649924.text: So many Ball Octopuses! And Mora, too! Can we keep them? Can we?

741649930.text: I'm sorry. I can't remember. Maybe it's something we've lost. Maybe not.

741649931.text: Let's take it for now. Maybe we'll find some use for it!

741649932.text: That took quite a long time... We're more or less finished here. Shall we go back to The Rusty Rudder?

741649933.text: That's the Ball Octopuses from before! Are they chasing us because we stole from them?

741649934.text: #{NICKNAME}! I charge you with the mission of defeating my arch-nemesis!

741649938.text: No sign of any treasure... Let's see if Urville has had any luck.

741649939.text: You then save Urville, who fell into the water, and return to the shore with Nadia before settling down for a break at The Rusty Rudder.
